ios.desc:
The Convenience of an App. The Support of a Real Person.
Report potholes, graffiti, broken streetlights, and other non-emergency issues in San Francisco in seconds. Add a photo, and the app suggests the right category and fills in details like vehicle license plates, saving you time.
Your report goes straight to the City departments for resolution.

Built for Everyone
Professionally translated by native speakers in English, Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Filipino, and Vietnamese. Meets WCAG accessibility standards.

Never Alone
Questions about your report or need to flag something the app doesn’t cover? Dial 311 from within San Francisco to speak with a real SF311 representative.

quotes.text:
Back when I lived in San Francisco I've met many people who used the SF311 app [0] where you can very quickly snap a picture and report an issue. One person I knew did so multiple times a day every day for many things – poop, trash, etc. The impressive thing was that the authorities would indeed show up often and clean things up.

[0]: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sf311/id666635420
